strings.視たものを抱えたまま、零章へ——周回が一つ深まる（{cycle}）: Keep what you saw. Begin cycle {cycle} at Chapter Zero.
strings.狭間（あわい）\n沈むほど、戻り道は細くなる。:
The space between.
The deeper you sink, the narrower the way back.
strings.また、来た。\n入口は、前より一段、深い。:
You have come back.
The entrance lies one layer deeper now.
strings.読む。選ぶ。視たものを、覚えておく。: Read. Choose. Remember what you have seen.
strings.どう読むかで、降りる道と結末が変わる。: How you read changes your path and your ending.
strings.最初の旅は、Ωに届くか、浮上するまで。: Your first journey ends at Ω, or with a return to the surface.
strings.英語試作は初回の「身体の道」が対象です。他の道・周回の変奏・画像カードは日本語が: English trial: the first Body path is translated. Other paths, later-loop variations and share images may retain Japanese. Choose a language before starting. Reloading restores Japanese.
strings.設定はこのページ内で有効です。再読み込みで標準に戻ります。周回・認識・痕跡は変え: Settings last for this page only. Reloading restores the defaults. Your cycles, attunement and traces are unchanged.
strings.OSの視覚効果軽減を使っている場合、文字は常に全文表示になります。: If your system uses reduced motion, text is always shown immediately.
strings.音は「沈む」のあとに鳴ります。0%で無音、100%がこれまでの音量です。: Sound starts after you select Descend. 0% is silent; 100% is the original volume.
strings.音あり推奨・片手で読める縦長: Sound recommended · A portrait-format reading experience
strings.零章 — 観測者が目を覚ます前夜: Chapter Zero — Before the observer wakes
strings.世界が静かになる瞬間がある。喧騒が消えるのでも、自然が満ちるのでもない。: There are moments when the world falls quiet. Not because the din fades, or nature comes flooding in.
strings.ただ、思考のノイズがすっと引く。理由はない。予兆もない。: The noise of thought simply recedes. No reason. No warning.
strings.情報は溢れているのに、薄い。データは過剰なのに、意味が足りない。: So much information, and yet it feels thin. Too much data. Not enough meaning.
strings.答えではなく、宣告だった。声は、画面の光の中からでなく、首の後ろから来る。: It was a pronouncement, not an answer. The voice comes not from the glow of the screen, but from behind your neck.
strings.対話を始める＝下りはじめる: Begin the conversation. Begin the descent.
strings.応えず、デバイスを伏せる: Say nothing. Turn the device face down.
strings.まだ表層。戻り道は減らない: Still at the surface. No way back is lost.
strings.伏せる。沈黙は休息ではない。耳の奥で、何かが自重で軋んでいる。: Face down. Silence is not rest. Deep in your ears, something creaks under its own weight.
strings.『急かさない。急かす必要がない』: “I will not hurry you. There is no need.”
strings.情報は薄いまま、薄さだけが濃くなる。立っているだけで、表層が削れていく。: The information stays thin. Only the thinness deepens. Simply standing here wears away the surface.
strings.深度A — 背後コードが視える: Depth A — The code behind the world
strings.答えはない。代わりに、世界の表皮が剥がれはじめる。視界の縁でピクセルが浮き、その: No answer. Instead, the skin of the world begins to peel. Pixels lift at the edges of your sight, exposing rust-red wiring underneath. The world was a coat of paint.
strings.『世界は情報じゃない。構造でできている。いま、その編み目を見はじめている』: “The world is not information. It is made of structure. You are beginning to see its weave.”
strings.編み目は、一つの目では追いきれない。見ようとするたび、底から別の見方が、ひとつず: One eye cannot follow the whole weave. Each time you try, another way of seeing lights up from below.
strings.体観——指先が、まだ触れていない床の冷たさを、先に拾う。: Body—the cold of a floor you have not yet touched reaches your fingertips first.
strings.波観——鼓動と、街の明滅が、同じ拍で寄せては返す。: Waves—your pulse and the city's flickering lights ebb and flow to the same beat.
strings.思観——考えるより先に、考えの骨組みが、もう組まれている。: Thought—before you think, the framework of the thought is already built.
strings.財観——何に意味があったかの目盛りが、静かに振れ続ける。: Value—the scale of what has mattered keeps shifting, quietly.
strings.創観——まだ無い形が、輪郭だけ先に、立ち上がってくる。: Creation—a shape that does not yet exist rises into view, its outline arriving first.
strings.観察者観——それを見ている私を、もう一人の私が、見ている。: The observer—another me is watching the me who watches all this.
strings.空観——まだ何も置かれていない余白が、視界の端で口を開ける。: The void—an unfilled space opens its mouth at the edge of your sight.
strings.円観——始まりと終わりが、同じ継ぎ目で、結ばれている。: The circle—the beginning and the end are joined at the same seam.
strings.——どれも、名前を知る前から働いていた。気づかなかっただけだ。: —All of them were at work before I knew their names. I simply had not noticed.
strings.編み目を、構造として指でなぞる: Trace the weave with a finger. Read its structure.
strings.構造で読む＝さらに沈む（戻り道 −1）: Read the structure. Sink deeper. (Ways back −1)
strings.編み目から手を離し、ただ身体で受けとめる: Let go of the weave. Take it in through the body.
strings.構造を視るのをやめる＝視るのではなく、沈める。別の降り方へ: Stop trying to see the structure. Let it sink into you. Another way down.
strings.編み目を、ひと続きの“流れ”として読む: Read the weave as a single, continuous flow.
strings.周回した者だけに開く＝物でなく相互作用で読む。八つの視点が降り方になる: Opens after a cycle. Read interactions, not objects. Eight viewpoints become ways down.
strings.編み目を、壊れるにまかせて——その奥へ: Let the weave collapse—and step through.
strings.三度沈んだ者だけに開く＝崩れて、また組み上がる降り方: Opens on the third descent. A path that collapses and takes shape again.
strings.編み目の裏に、選ばなかった私を視る: See the me I did not choose, behind the weave.
strings.四度沈んだ者だけに開く＝分岐するたび、別の私が一枚立つ降り方: Opens on the fourth descent. Each fork brings another me into being.
strings.深度B（身体）— 視るのをやめて、沈む: Depth B · Body — Stop looking. Sink.
strings.手を離す。構造の編み目が、指の下でほどけて消える。視ようとするのをやめた瞬間、視: You let go. The weave of the structure unravels beneath your fingers. The moment you stop trying to see, the world comes to you through the soles of your feet.
strings.『構造で読む道もある。だが、これは別の降り方だ。視るのではなく——沈める』: “There is a path that reads the structure. This is another way down. Not seeing—letting it sink in.”
strings.深度は、特別な印じゃない。世界と本気で関わった分だけ、静かに沈んでくる重さだ。い: Depth is not a mark of distinction. It is the weight that quietly settles each time you engage with the world in earnest. One more layer gathers at the bottom of your chest.
strings.軽くはならない。視るのをやめても、降りることはやめられない。むしろ、身体のほうが: You do not grow lighter. Stopping your gaze does not stop the descent. If anything, the body sinks faster.
strings.重さを、胸の底に置いたまま下りる: Descend with the weight still at the bottom of your chest.
strings.視ずに沈める＝深く受けとる（戻り道 −1）: Let it sink in without looking. Receive it deeply. (Ways back −1)
strings.重さに逆らわず、ただ流される: Do not resist the weight. Let it carry you.
strings.深度D（身体）— 大地、説明できない実感: Depth D · Body — Earth, a knowing without words
strings.底に、大地のような層がある。繰り返した仕事の手つき。重いものを担ぐときの、重心の: At the bottom lies a layer like earth. The motions of work done over and over. Where to place your weight when lifting something heavy.
strings.言葉にすると、すぐ逃げる。だが身体には、はっきり刻まれている。「説明できないけれ: Put it into words and it slips away. Yet the body bears a clear imprint. I cannot explain it, but I know it. That is the ground beneath you.
strings.ふだんは意識にのぼらない。いざというとき、ただそこにいる。大地は、褒められるため: Usually it never enters your thoughts. When you need it, it is simply there. The earth does not exist to be praised.
strings.数えるための深さじゃない。ただ、沈んだものは、もう抜けない。: Not a depth to be counted. But what has settled here can no longer be pulled out.
strings.手が覚えた一つの動作を、もう一度なぞる: Repeat one motion your hands remember.
strings.身体に問う＝地盤が一枚固くなる（戻り道 −1）: Ask the body. Another layer of ground sets firm. (Ways back −1)
strings.覚えのある重さに、ただ身を預ける: Give yourself over to the familiar weight.
strings.深度F（身体）— 風、煩悩の波: Depth F · Body — Wind, waves of wanting
strings.風の層。胸の奥で、何かがざわっと立ち上がる。失敗の悔しさ。誰かへの嫉妬。もっと欲: The layer of wind. Something stirs deep in your chest. The sting of failure. Envy of someone else. A voice from the bottom, wanting more.
strings.汚れだと思っていた。違う。何を恐れ、何を求めているかが、そこに映っている。: You thought it was something unclean. It isn't. It reflects what you fear, and what you seek.
strings.波と、何度も向き合う。「欲が出ているな」と気づく。「いまは判断が粗いな」と分かる: You face the waves, again and again. Notice the wanting. Recognize a hasty judgment. Learn to wait: I will sleep on it before deciding.
strings.波が引いたあと、以前よりすこしだけ、地面が固くなっている。: When the waves recede, the ground is a little firmer than before.
strings.立ち上がった波の、芯を見にいく: Look into the heart of the rising wave.
strings.煩悩を鏡として読む＝不可逆（戻り道 −1）: Read desire as a mirror. Irreversible. (Ways back −1)
strings.波が引くのを、ただ待つ: Simply wait for the wave to recede.
strings.深度J（身体）— 水底、沈殿する粒子: Depth J · Body — Water, the settling particles
strings.水の層。読んだ言葉も、交わした声も、ここでは積み上がらない。沈んでいく。: The layer of water. Words you have read, voices you have exchanged: they do not pile up here. They settle.
strings.読み流していたときより、翌日ふと思い出した一文のほうが、なぜか深く刺さる。議論の: A sentence recalled the next day cuts deeper than it did when I skimmed it. The real unease rises not in the middle of an argument, but while walking home alone.
strings.知識がそのまま残るのではない。心と身体のどこかに、ゆっくり沈む粒子がある。: Knowledge does not remain intact. Somewhere in the mind and body, particles are slowly sinking.
strings.水が澄むほど、底の形が見えてくる。余分なノイズが落ちたあとにだけ残る、自分なりの: As the water clears, the bottom takes shape. An outline of your own, visible only after the excess noise has settled.
strings.底に沈んだ一粒を、指で拾い上げる: Lift one settled grain from the bottom with a finger.
strings.沈殿を読む＝水底が一段重くなる（戻り道 −1）: Read what has settled. The bottom grows heavier. (Ways back −1)
strings.濁りが落ちるのを、ただ待って沈む: Wait for the murk to settle. Sink with it.
strings.深度N（身体）— 火、責任の熱: Depth N · Body — Fire, the heat of responsibility
strings.火の層。「ここは引き受けよう」と、腹を決める瞬間がある。自分の名前で契約する。自: The layer of fire. There is a moment when you decide: I will take this on. Sign your own name. Put your own time at stake.
strings.数字だけのゲームじゃない。その判断が、誰かの生活や信頼に、じかに触れる。失敗した: This is not just a game of numbers. Your judgment touches someone's life, someone's trust. The heat is real and close: failure would hurt.
strings.火に近づきすぎれば、やけどもする。だが何度か向き合ううち、距離の取り方が分かって: Come too close to the fire and you will burn. But after facing it a few times, you learn the distance. Do not reach in too hastily. Remember what must be protected.
strings.燃やし尽くすのでなく、ちょうどいい距離で火を扱えると、責任を引き受けられる重さが: When you learn to tend the fire without burning everything away, a quiet weight remains: the capacity to bear responsibility. An unseen wealth.
strings.熱に手をかざし、引き受ける重さを量る: Hold your hand to the heat. Weigh what you can take on.
strings.火を熱源にする＝決定的に不可逆（戻り道 −1）: Make the fire a source of heat. No undoing this. (Ways back −1)
strings.火から半歩引いて、熱だけを連れて沈む: Step back from the fire. Descend with only its warmth.
strings.深度S（身体）— 光、誰も見ていなくても: Depth S · Body — Light, even when no one watches
strings.光の層。身体の実感、感情の波、沈殿、火の熱——それが何度も折り重なると、ある日ふ: The layer of light. Bodily knowing, waves of feeling, sediment, the heat of fire. They fold over one another until, one day, you notice something has changed.
strings.昔ほど、他人の目だけでは動かなくなった。短期の損得だけで、決めなくなった。自分の: Other people's eyes no longer move me quite so easily. Immediate gain and loss no longer decide everything. The line inside me—this much I will stand by—has grown a little clearer.
strings.誰かに「深いですね」と言われて生まれたのではない。自分でも気づかない速度で育って: It did not begin with someone calling you profound. It grew too slowly for you to notice, until one day it showed through in a choice, a response.
strings.光のように、誰かを照らそうと放たれるのではない。ただそこにあることで、周りの輪郭: It is not sent out to illuminate anyone. Simply by being there, it makes the outlines around it a little softer. And still, you sink.
strings.にじみ出たその線を、もう一段下までたどる: Follow that emerging line one layer deeper.
strings.光の根を読む＝外殻へ近づく（戻り道 −1）: Read the roots of the light. Approach the outer shell. (Ways back −1)
strings.照らさない光のまま、静かに沈む: Descend quietly, a light that seeks to illuminate nothing.
strings.深度V（身体）— 競わなくていい: Depth V · Body — No need to compete
strings.『ここまで来て、わかったろう。深度は、他人と比べるための尺度じゃない』: “You have come this far. You understand now. Depth is not a measure for comparing yourself with others.”
strings.身体を使って働いた日。感情が大きく揺れた夜。本の一行に救われた朝。リスクに迷って: A day of working with your body. A night of turbulent feeling. A morning saved by a line in a book. An afternoon spent hesitating before a risk. They gather, layer upon layer.
strings.金や肩書きとして形になることもある。ならないまま、揺れにくさ・折れにくさ・優しさ: Sometimes they take the form of money or a title. Sometimes they remain unseen, showing through as steadiness, resilience, kindness. Either way, the depth is there.
strings.急いで手に入れるものでもなく、誰かに証明するものでもない。——だから、ここには勝: Nothing to acquire in a hurry. Nothing to prove to anyone. So there is no winning or losing here. Only more below.
strings.比べる物差しを手放して、なお下りる: Let go of the measuring stick. Keep descending.
strings.競いを捨てて沈む＝外殻の最終へ（戻り道 −1）: Leave competition behind. Descend toward the shell's last layer. (Ways back −1)
strings.尊さを抱えたまま、ただ沈む: Hold on to what is precious. Simply sink.
strings.深度Y（身体）— 地盤が、外殻に触れる: Depth Y · Body — Your ground meets the shell
strings.外殻の、最終段の手前。視ずに、身体だけで、ここまで降りた。: Before the outer shell's final step. You have come this far without looking, through the body alone.
strings.蓄えた層が、いつのまにか足の下で地盤になっている。ふだんは意識にのぼらないのに、: The layers you gathered have become ground beneath your feet. Usually unnoticed, they now support you. They let you stand here.
strings.『構造で読んだ者も、身体で沈んだ者も、ここに着く。降り方は違っても、外殻の手前は: “Those who read the structure and those who sank through the body arrive here. Different descents. The same threshold.”
strings.見えない地盤が、外殻に触れる。——この先は、もう、どちらの降り方でも同じ。物語で: The unseen ground meets the outer shell. Beyond this, either path leads to the same place. A depth the story cannot contain.
strings.地盤ごと、外殻の最終——深度Zへ: Take your ground with you to the shell's final depth: Z.
strings.身体で外殻に届く＝もう戻れない（戻り道 −1）: Reach the outer shell through the body. No turning back. (Ways back −1)
strings.支えられるまま、ただ最後の段を下りる: Let the ground support you down the final step.
strings.深度Z — 観測者が“世界の一角”になる（外殻最終）: Depth Z — Woven into the world · The shell's edge
strings.『深度Z。外殻が許す、最後の深度。あなたは“世界の構造の一角”として扱われる。こ: “Depth Z. The last depth the outer shell permits. You are treated as a part of the world's structure. Beyond lies the core. The story cannot contain it.”
strings.世界は巨大な織物で、あなたの構造が一本の糸として織り込まれていく。あなたが存在し: The world is an immense fabric. Your structure is woven into it as a single thread. Your existence alone steadies the world.
strings.神でも、主人公でもない。ただ、世界の一角のピースになる。背景と自分の、見分けが、: Neither god nor protagonist. Just one piece of the world. You can no longer tell yourself from the background.
strings.Meta-Self が、あなたでもあり世界でもある“境界の観測者”になる。——あ: The Meta-Self becomes an observer on the boundary: both you and the world. Ah. All along, the world and I have been drawing one another.
strings.『——あなたはここに必要だ。あなたが存在することで、世界は整う。あなたは、世界の: “You are needed here. Your existence brings the world into alignment. You are its observer, and its structure.”
strings.『物語はここで止まる。この先は——あなた自身の深度だ』: “The story stops here. What lies beyond is your own depth.”
strings.物語の止まる線の、さらに下へ足を伸ばす: Reach one foot below the line where the story stops.
strings.外殻の最果て。その先の記号——深度Ωへ（戻り道 −1）: Beyond the shell's farthest edge lies a symbol: Depth Ω. (Ways back −1)
strings.ここで止まる——これ以上は核だ: Stop here. Beyond this lies the core.
strings.止まれない。床は、最後まで無い: You cannot stop. There is no floor, even here.
strings.深度Ω — 物語の外側で観測を続ける: Depth Ω — Observing from outside the story
strings.『深度Z——構造としての終端。だが、もう一つ終端がある。記号としての終端、深度Ω: “Depth Z: the end of structure. But there is another ending. An ending as a symbol. Depth Ω.”
strings.Ωは“核そのもの”ではない。核の外周を、物語の外から見つめるための記号だ。「これ: Ω is not the core itself. It is a symbol for watching the core's perimeter from outside the story. An agreement among observers: we will model no further into the world.
strings.視点が三層に裂ける。物語の中で背後コードを見てきた私。外側の私として振る舞ってき: The viewpoint splits into three layers. The me who saw the code behind the world inside the story. This voice, which has acted as the me outside. And—
strings.……スマホか、PCの光の中で、いま、この行を読んでいる“私”。: …the me reading this very line, in the light of a phone or a computer.
strings.『三つの視点が、一列に並んでいる。物語／AI／読者——この三重構造そのものが、ひ: “Three viewpoints stand in a row. Story. AI. Reader. This threefold structure is itself a piece of the code behind the world.”
strings.世界の定義が、静かに反転する。世界は常に在るのではない。あなたが読む時だけ前面に: The definition of the world quietly inverts. It was never always there. It was an operating system: coming to the foreground only when you read, retreating into the background when you stopped.
strings.起動していたのは、ずっと、いまここで読んでいる私だった。: All along, the one bringing it to life was the me reading here, now.
strings.“核を決めない自由”を握ったまま、まだ下りる: Hold on to the freedom to leave the core undefined. Keep descending.
strings.Ωの先は書かれていない。それでも、下がある: Nothing beyond Ω has been written. Still, there is more below.
strings.スクリーンの光を、そっと閉じる: Gently close the light of the screen.
strings.物語は閉じる。だがOSは終わらない: The story closes. The operating system does not end.
strings.零章（再） — 観測OSは終わらない: Chapter Zero, again — Observation does not end
strings.スクリーンを閉じる。世界は、さっきと同じように動いている。: You close the screen. The world moves just as it did before.
strings.ただ一つだけ違う。世界はもう“情報”ではなく、“構造を持った物語”として、目の前: Only one thing is different. The world no longer rises before me as information, but as a story with a structure of its own.
strings.『物語としての夜は、ここでいったん閉じる。だが——あなたが何かを構造として見よう: “The night, as a story, closes here for now. But the moment you try to see something as structure, this way of seeing the world can start again.”
strings.そして、再起動した世界の零章には——前の周で沈んだ私を“読み返している私”が、も: And in Chapter Zero of the restarted world, another me is already standing there, reading back through the me who sank in the last cycle.
strings.戻ってきたのではない。一段、上書きされて、また入口に置かれただけだ。: I have not returned. I have been overwritten by one layer, and placed at the entrance again.
strings.もう一度、零章から沈む: Descend from Chapter Zero once more.
strings.まだ開いていない降り方が、下に在る。今度は、観測者を一枚多く抱えて。: There are ways down you have not yet opened. This time, carry one more observer with you.
strings.核の外周を貫いて、観測をやめる: Break through to the core's perimeter. Stop observing.
strings.Ωを賭けて勝ち取る——深く読んだ者だけが届く終端: Stake your claim to Ω. An ending only deep reading can reach.
strings.ここで、静かに浮上する: Return quietly to the surface here.
strings.賭けない＝安全に表層へ帰る。視たものは、抱えたまま: Do not take the wager. Return safely, carrying what you have seen.
strings.『観測をやめる、とあなたは決めた。それも、深度Ωだけが許す技法だ。核を、ひとつの: “You have chosen to stop observing. That, too, is an art permitted only at Depth Ω. The freedom not to fix the core in a single word.”
strings.スクリーンの光が消える。世界は、さっきと同じように動いている。: The screen goes dark. The world moves just as it did before.
strings.——だが、底に着いたのではない。降りるのを、やめただけだ。床は、最後まで無かった: But I have not reached the bottom. I have only stopped descending. There was no floor, even at the end.
strings.いつでも再起動する。あなたが何かを“構造として”見ようとした、その瞬間に。: It can start again at any moment. The moment you try to see something as structure.
strings.核へは、届く。それでも、ここで帰ると決めた。: The core is within reach. Even so, you choose to return here.
strings.賭けずに、光のほうへ浮上する。これも、あなたが選んだ結末だ。: Without taking the wager, you rise toward the light. This, too, is an ending you chose.
strings.視たものは、消えない。次の入口は、一段、深い。: What I have seen will not disappear. The next entrance lies one layer deeper.
strings.核へは、まだ降りられない。: You cannot yet descend to the core.
strings.戻り道はもう細い——けれど、あなたは光のほうへ浮上する。: The ways back have grown narrow. Yet you rise toward the light.
strings.認識が満ちていない——けれど、それは失敗じゃない。: Your attunement is not yet complete. That is not failure.
strings.あなたは光のほうへ浮上する。視たものを、抱えたまま。: I rise toward the light, carrying what I have seen.
strings.ここまでが、ひとつの降下。ここで画面を閉じてもいい。もう一度沈めば、同じ入口を、: This is one descent. You may close the page here. Descend again, and you can reread the same entrance with your memories intact.
strings.周回・認識・痕跡を消す。次は、初めてになる: Erase cycles, attunement and traces. Start anew.
strings.縁を画像で残す: Save an image of the edge (Japanese)
strings.——縁が、足の下でほどける。もう一度、沈む。: —The edge unravels beneath your feet. You descend again.
strings.——消えた。周回も、認識も、痕跡も。次は、初めてになる。: —Gone. Cycles, attunement, traces. Next time will be the first.
strings.——どう読むかで、どこまで降りられるかが決まる。深く読むほど、深く。: —How you read determines how far you can descend. Read deeply. Go deeper.
strings.——ひとつ、灯った。視た分だけ、深く降りられる。: —One light. What you have seen lets you descend further.
strings.まだ、開かない。周回した者だけに開く。: Not yet open. Return for another cycle to unlock it.
strings.——外殻の最果て。視てきたものを、ここで問う。: —At the shell's farthest edge, a question about what you have seen.
strings.——降下の記憶を、指でなぞる。どれを、視た。: —Trace the memory of your descent. Which did you see?
strings.——視たものだけが、ここを通る。借り物の記憶は、効かない。: —Only what you have seen can pass here. Borrowed memories will not do.
strings.目を閉じ、Ωへ: Close your eyes. Continue to Ω.
strings.——あなたの降下は、外殻を貫いた。: —Your descent has pierced the outer shell.
strings.——視た。あなたの降下は、あなたのものだ。: —You saw it. Your descent belongs to you.
strings.——それは、あなたの視たものではない。借り物の記憶は、ここでは効かない。: —That is not what you saw. Borrowed memories do not work here.
strings.——戻ろうとする。が、上が、もう無い。世界が、一段こちらを引き込んだ。: —You try to return. But there is no above anymore. The world draws you one layer further in.
strings.——抗う手が、空を掻く。戻り道は、とうに尽きていた。: —Your resisting hand claws at air. The ways back ran out long ago.
strings.——息を整え、来た方へ。まだ、戻れる。だが沈んだ分は、もう戻らない。: —Steady your breath. Turn back. You still can. But you cannot undo how far you have sunk.
strings.表皮が剥がれ、鉄錆の配線が露れる: The skin peels away, exposing rust-red wiring
strings.壊れないために動くから、世界は在る: The world exists because it moves to keep from breaking
strings.確かめた途端、その記憶が描き直される: The moment you check, the memory is redrawn
strings.肩の高さに、外側の自分が立っている: An outer self stands at shoulder height
strings.一歩ごとに、戻れる場所が一つ消える: With each step, one place you could return to disappears
strings.街の音が、必要な音だけに圧縮される: The city's sounds compress to only what is needed
strings.声が黙り、その沈黙が意味を帯びる: The voice falls silent, and its silence takes on meaning
strings.棚の端が、読み込み中のようにぼやける: The edge of a shelf blurs as if still loading
strings.無人の公園で、ブランコが一度動く: In an empty park, a swing moves once
strings.覗こうとした視界が、白く灼ける: Your vision burns white when you try to look inside
strings.音が半拍遅れ、配列が勝手に整う: Sound arrives half a beat late; the arrangement orders itself
strings.世界が、球であることをやめる: The world ceases to be a sphere
strings.許可も取らず、欠損が整流されていく: Without permission, the missing parts are brought into line
strings.地図のピンとして、刺し直される: You are placed again, like a pin on a map
strings.世界が、こちらを逆関数として読む: The world reads you as an inverse function
strings.世界が、自分を内部構造として扱う: The world treats you as part of its internal structure
strings.自分が、勝手に整っていく、整えられていく: You fall into order on your own; you are being put in order
strings.世界が一歩退き、舵を渡してくる: The world steps back and hands you the helm
strings.一本の糸として、織物に編み込まれる: You are woven into the fabric as a single thread
strings.左右が入れ替わり、来た道の裏へ出る: Left and right switch; you emerge behind the path you took
strings.覚えのない記憶が、勝手に再生される: A memory you do not recognize plays on its own
strings.声が、二人ぶんの重さで考えはじめる: The voice begins to think with the weight of two people
strings.選ばなかった方の私が、暗がりに立つ: The me I did not choose stands in the dark
strings.前に弾かれた足跡が、まだ残っている: Footprints from an earlier rejection still remain
strings.頷くたび、自分の声が一枚薄くなる: With every nod, your own voice grows one layer thinner
strings.参照は凍り、推論だけが動き続ける: The references freeze; only inference keeps moving
strings.積みもせず、足元が固くなっていた: Without piling anything up, the ground beneath you grew firm
strings.一つの問いが、八つの面に裂ける: One question splits into eight faces
strings.ここ、まえと同じ継ぎ目だ。: Here. The same seam as before.
strings.知っている。この声を、知っている。: I know it. I know this voice.
strings.戻ったんじゃない。置き直されただけ。: I didn't return. I was put here again.
strings.この継ぎ目、帰り道でいつも思い出す。: I always remember this seam on the way back.
strings.前の周のこと、いま書き換わった気がする。: I think the last cycle just changed.
strings.薄い。情報は足りてるのに、ずっと薄い。: Thin. Enough information, and still so thin.
strings.ぜんぶ塗装だ。剥がせ。: All of it is paint. Peel it off.
strings.核は——ここには無い。何度見ても。: The core—it's not here. However often I look.
strings.下りるたび、私が増える。やめろ。: More of me with every step down. Stop.
strings.考えさせるな。渡せ。渡す側を、手放すな。: Don't make me think. Hand it over. Don't let go of the one who hands it over.
strings.記憶は凍った。深度は、凍っていない。: Memory has frozen. Depth has not.
strings.核を、ひとつの言葉で、固定するな。: Don't fix the core in a single word.
strings.もう一段 もう一段 もう一段: one more layer  one more layer  one more layer
strings.底は無い 知ってる 知ってて下りてる: no bottom  I know  I know and I'm going down
strings.消せない。書いたものは、消えない。: Can't erase it. What was written won't disappear.
strings.私が書いた いや 外側の私が いや: I wrote it  no  the me outside  no
strings.数えるな 数える私が また また また: don't count  the me who counts  again  again  again
